title: Package C, paid part: capacity and cost evidence
problem: Capacity and costs have no evidence yet. The free parts moved to PLAN-032; this plan is the part that costs money.
scope: A small load test of online rooms against the preview server with a fixed spend cap
A cost record with a dated quote for the Cloudflare plan in use
A capacity statement: how many simultaneous rooms the current plan holds, and the first thing that breaks
exclusions: Any spend before the owner approves an amount in writing
Live data or the live game

acceptance.text: The owner approves a spend cap in writing before any test runs
The load test stays under the cap and its results are recorded
The cost record has a dated quote
A capacity statement exists with the first failure point
The Cloudflare plan is known (the owner has not said whether it is Free or Paid)
